about_the_game:
About the Free Demo

Push your oshi to the top!

Roll and push adorable hololive members' "treasures" to the goal in this simple 3D action game — a must-play for hololive fans!

Try out the demo version of hololive GoroGoro Mountain, a fun and easy 3D action game!

In this demo, you can play a special stage.

Keep matching treasures and push them up to the summit!

Note: Save data from the free demo cannot be transferred to the full version.

How to Play

Just roll the treasures around!

Combine the same treasures to transform them into even bigger ones!

If you stop playing, it's game over! But as long as you don't give up, you can keep challenging yourself endlessly!

Collect coins along the way to power up!

Create the biggest treasure and aim for the top!
